title: Stance Formulas: Expressing Degrees of Conviction & Subjective Perspective
primaryPurpose: Introduce nuanced lexical formulas for articulating personal stances, varying from tentative conjecture (миний бодлоор, миний ажигласнаар) to firm conviction (миний бат итгэлтэй байгаагаар, эргэлзээгүй).
communicativeOutcome: Express subjective stances on social and professional topics with calibrated epistemic certainty.
writingObjective: Draft 5 statements expressing varying degrees of certainty on public transit modernization.
spokenProductionObjective: Orally state your viewpoint on remote work flexibility using calibrated stance markers.
registerTarget: Intellectual discussion and formal conversational register
pragmaticTarget: Using parenthetical stance markers to signal openness to interlocutor dialogue.
reviewReason: Transforms reported speech citation into personalized subjective stance framing.
audioPurpose: Model parenthetical comma pauses preceding stance phrases like 'Миний хувьд авч үзвэл...'.
successCriteria: Differentiates between strong conviction and tentative hypothesis markers
Positions stance expressions correctly in sentence initial or medial topical slots
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Миний ажигласнаар бол энэ шийдвэр урт хугацаандаа эерэг үр дүн авчирна' accurately.

title: Reading Analysis: Contemporary Mongolian Newspaper Editorials & Columns
primaryPurpose: Deconstruct authentic editorial opinion columns from leading Mongolian publications analyzing social reforms, youth entrepreneurship, and urban lifestyle shifts.
communicativeOutcome: Distinguish between objective factual evidence, journalistic interpretation, and editorial value judgments.
readingObjective: Read a 300-word editorial on urban green spaces and identify the author's primary thesis and 2 supporting arguments.
registerTarget: High literary and journalistic analytical register
pragmaticTarget: Separating subjective ideological framing from verifiable empirical data.
reviewReason: Extends analytical reading from corporate dispute cases to public socio-political editorials.
audioPurpose: Narration of editorial prose with persuasive rhetorical inflection.
successCriteria: Identifies the author's core ideological stance across 2 divergent opinion columns
Extracts rhetorical question devices and stance collocations from texts
masteryEvidence: Identifies that the author endorses pedestrian zones while rejecting vehicular congestion fees.

title: Discussion: Debating Urban Development & Quality of Life in Ulaanbaatar
primaryPurpose: Participate in a structured discussion evaluating municipal initiatives such as bicycle lanes, smog reduction subsidies, and public transit overhaul.
communicativeOutcome: Articulate and defend nuanced perspectives on civic issues, building upon peers' arguments collaboratively.

registerTarget: Public intellectual civic debate register
pragmaticTarget: Validating others' concerns while introducing alternative urban perspectives.
reviewReason: Applies debate and roundtable conventions to public policy and civic infrastructure themes.
audioPurpose: Provide discussion questions and counter-arguments by multiple native speakers.
successCriteria: Contributes multiple coherent turns integrating targeted stance formulas
Substantiates viewpoints with concrete urban examples from Mongolian life
masteryEvidence: Articulates 'Миний бодлоор дугуйн замыг нэмэгдүүлснээр түгжрэл буурах боловч өвлийн цагт аюулгүй байдлыг хангах шаардлагатай' effectively.

title: Writing Workshop: Authoring a 150-Word Opinion Column
primaryPurpose: Compose a structured 150-word opinion piece (Нийтлэл) defending a personal stance on education, technology, or urban living with clear argumentative progression.
communicativeOutcome: Produce a well-reasoned argumentative essay featuring a clear thesis statement, supporting evidence, and balanced conclusion.
writingObjective: Author a 150-word essay defending an educational reform proposal with thesis, 2 body arguments, and conclusion.
registerTarget: Formal written analytical essay register
pragmaticTarget: Maintaining persuasive momentum without relying on emotional hyperbole.
reviewReason: Transitions structured formal writing from business correspondence to public opinion essay authorship.
audioPurpose: Provide audio readback of the authored editorial text.
successCriteria: Produces distinct Introduction (with hook and thesis), Body, and Conclusion sections
Integrates at least 3 distinct stance phrases with flawless grammatical syntax
masteryEvidence: Submits an essay opening with 'Орчин үеийн нийгэмд дижитал ур чадвар зайлшгүй шаардлагатай болж байна' and sustaining clear logic throughout.

title: Diplomatic Rebuttal: Concessive Openings & Counter-Argument Formulas
primaryPurpose: Introduce rhetorical concession-and-rebuttal formulas (тийм боловч, таны хэлдэг зөв ч гэсэн, нөгөө талаас нь авч үзвэл) to dispute opposing views without causing offense.
communicativeOutcome: Formulate polite, face-saving rebuttals in professional and academic settings.
writingObjective: Draft 4 polite rebuttal sentences responding to controversial business assertions.
spokenProductionObjective: Diplomatically counter a colleague's proposal while validating their good intentions.
registerTarget: High formal parliamentary and intellectual debate register
pragmaticTarget: Preserving interlocutor face by acknowledging partial validity before introducing counter-evidence.
reviewReason: Deepens diplomatic workplace de-escalation into formal academic and rhetorical counter-argumentation.
audioPurpose: Model soothing fall-rise intonation contours during concessive clauses.
successCriteria: Selects appropriate concessive connectors (-вч, боловч, хэдий ч) to frame counterpoints
Maintains courteous, non-aggressive register throughout rebuttal assertions
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Таны хэлж байгаа санаа маш сонирхолтой хэдий ч бодит нөхцөл байдалд хэрэгжихэд учир дутагдалтай байна' fluently.

title: Acoustic Decoding: Counter-Arguments in Academic Symposiums
primaryPurpose: Develop auditory listening comprehension for rapid, formal academic exchanges and conference Q&A sessions where researchers debate findings.
communicativeOutcome: Identify the core critique, empirical objections, and proposed methodological refinements in spoken symposium debates.
listeningObjective: Listen to a 2-minute academic debate audio and identify 2 methodological flaws raised by the respondent.
registerTarget: Formal academic symposium conference register
pragmaticTarget: Distinguishing professional scientific disagreement from personal hostility in speech.

successCriteria: Identifies the speaker's main counter-claim and specific evidentiary challenge
Recognizes concessive discourse markers in natural academic delivery
masteryEvidence: Correctly transcribes that the questioner contested the sample size of the economic study.

title: Interactive Simulation: The Formal Parliamentary Debate
primaryPurpose: Engage in an interactive parliamentary-style debate defending or opposing a motion on renewable energy mandates or university tuition subsidies.
communicativeOutcome: Present opening arguments, respond to points of information, and deliver an impromptu rebuttal adhering to formal debate protocol.
listeningObjective: Comprehend opponent arguments delivered during debate turns and formulate rapid rebuttals.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver a 2-minute structured rebuttal speech dismantling the opposing side's core economic assumptions.
registerTarget: Parliamentary debate standard register
pragmaticTarget: Using formal address formulas (Эрхэм даргалагч, хүндэт сөрөг тал) to maintain decorum.
reviewReason: Synthesizes opinion stances and polite rebuttals in a high-stakes competitive debate format.
audioPurpose: Prompt learner turns with native debate opponents presenting sharp counter-arguments.
successCriteria: Delivers a 2-minute rebuttal addressing at least 2 points made by the opposing team
Employs concessive structures and formal debate protocols without code-switching
masteryEvidence: Delivers 'Сөрөг талын дурдсан зардал өндөр гэдэгтэй санал нийлэх боловч байгаль орчны хохирлыг тооцвол сэргээгдэх эрчим хүч илүү хэмнэлттэй' eloquently.

title: Writing Workshop: Authoring a Formal Letter of Counter-Argument
primaryPurpose: Compose an official 150-word letter of rebuttal responding to an unfair audit report or contested committee finding.
communicativeOutcome: Produce a dignified, evidentiary written rebuttal that disputes specific charges while preserving institutional goodwill.
writingObjective: Draft a 150-word formal letter disputing an institutional assessment with 3 specific counter-arguments and documentary references.
registerTarget: Formal administrative legalistic epistolary register
pragmaticTarget: Maintaining professional courtesy and objective evidentiary tone when contesting official judgments.
reviewReason: Synthesizes administrative writing from internal reconciliation to external formal rebuttal advocacy.
audioPurpose: Provide auditory verification of written rebuttal syntax.
successCriteria: Produces formal correspondence structure with salutation, point-by-point rebuttal, and request for review
Uses concessive and passive grammatical constructions accurately throughout
masteryEvidence: Writes 'Аудитын дүгнэлтэд дурдсан зөрчлийг хүндэтгэн үзэж байгаа хэдий ч дараах баримтууд дутуу тусгагдсан гэж үзэж байна' flawlessly.

title: Morphosyntax of Causality: Postpositional Connectors -аас/ээс учраас and тул
primaryPurpose: Introduce the syntactic mechanisms of complex causal subordination in Mongolian: 1) Ablative participle + учраас (-сан/-х учраас), 2) Direct causal postposition тул (-сан/-х тул), and 3) Explanatory sentence-initial connector Учир нь.
communicativeOutcome: Formulate multi-clause causal sentences expressing reasons, justifications, and systemic consequences.
writingObjective: Combine 6 pairs of independent clauses into complex causal sentences using учраас, тул, and учир нь.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain the causes of a project delay using both subordinate (учраас) and coordinating (учир нь) causal frames.
registerTarget: Standard formal spoken and written analytical register
pragmaticTarget: Distinguishing pre-posed cause (тул/учраас) from post-posed explanatory justification (Учир нь...).
reviewReason: Equips learners with syntactic causality mechanisms to substantiate personal stances.
audioPurpose: Model comma pauses after subordinate causal clauses ending in учраас and тул.
successCriteria: Selects ablative participle before учраас and unmarked participle before тул
Places 'Учир нь' at the start of a secondary explanatory sentence followed by genitive subject
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Цас их орсон учраас нислэг хойшлогдлоо' and 'Нислэг хойшлогдлоо. Учир нь цас их оров' accurately.

title: Guided Practice: Precision in Causal Subordination (Тул vs Учраас vs Учир нь)
primaryPurpose: Provide structured syntactic drills mastering subtle register and stylistic differences between bureaucratic тул, neutral учраас, and emphatic explanatory Учир нь.
communicativeOutcome: Skillfully choose between causal connectors based on formal register, clause weight, and discourse focus.
writingObjective: Rewrite 6 casual causal sentences into formal administrative prose using -х тул.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver 3 rapid spoken justifications for strategic decisions using varying causal connectors.
registerTarget: Formal administrative and academic register
pragmaticTarget: Using тул in administrative decrees to signal institutional necessity.
reviewReason: Consolidates causal morphosyntax through intensive contrastive sentence manipulation.
audioPurpose: Synthesize formal causal utterances contrasting oral and written rhythm.
successCriteria: Consistently applies -х тул in official notices and business memoranda
Integrates 'Учир нь' correctly to open independent explanatory sentences
masteryEvidence: Converts 'Бид яарч байгаа учраас хурал эхэлье' into 'Цаг хугацаа хомс буй тул хурлыг эхлүүлье' accurately.

title: Reading Analysis: Socio-Economic Whitepapers on Demographic Migration
primaryPurpose: Deconstruct authentic sociological reports examining the causes of rural-to-urban migration from Western aimags to Ulaanbaatar.
communicativeOutcome: Extract cause-and-effect chains, economic push/pull factors, and policy recommendations from analytical texts.
readingObjective: Read an excerpt from a national statistical report and diagram 3 economic causes and 2 social effects of urbanization.
registerTarget: Formal sociological and statistical research register
pragmaticTarget: Distinguishing correlation from direct causation in formal Mongolian prose.
reviewReason: Deepens analytical reading from journalistic editorials to evidence-based sociological whitepapers.
audioPurpose: Audio narration of sociological report passages.
successCriteria: Identifies cause clauses marked by тул and учраас across 3 statistical excerpts
Maps multi-tier cause-and-effect relationships into a visual causal chain
masteryEvidence: Identifies that 'Ажлын байр дутмаг байгаагаас шалтгаалан залуучууд хот руу шилжиж байна' identifies the primary economic driver.

title: Acoustic Comprehension: Television Panel on Inflationary Pressures & Supply Chains
primaryPurpose: Develop listening comprehension for complex macroeconomic roundtable broadcasts where economists explain currency fluctuations, fuel tariffs, and consumer price indices.
communicativeOutcome: Track spoken causal reasoning explaining why prices fluctuate and what monetary interventions are projected.
listeningObjective: Listen to a 2.5-minute televised economic debate and transcribe the 3 root causes of inflation identified by the lead analyst.
registerTarget: High-register broadcast analytical panel discussion
pragmaticTarget: Tracking rapid spoken causal shifts where economists use nested subordinate clauses.
reviewReason: Expands broadcast listening from news bulletins to unscripted expert panel debates.
audioPurpose: Authentic studio broadcast recording featuring two economists with fast-paced natural analytical delivery.
successCriteria: Identifies the primary and secondary causal factors cited for price inflation
Distinguishes between domestic supply constraints and imported external cost pressures
masteryEvidence: Summarizes accurately that international transport bottlenecks and rising oil prices were identified as prime inflation catalysts.

title: Spoken Production: Delivering an Analytical Briefing on Root Causes
primaryPurpose: Deliver a 2-minute oral analytical briefing diagnosing why a major project exceeded budget or failed to meet deadlines, substantiating findings with causal connectors.
communicativeOutcome: Present a structured root-cause analysis orally to an audience of supervisors or stakeholders.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver a 2-minute oral briefing presenting a 3-step causal breakdown of an operational delay.
registerTarget: Formal professional analytical presentation register
pragmaticTarget: Focusing objectively on systemic failure points rather than interpersonal finger-pointing.
reviewReason: Elevates operational accident reports to structured systemic causal analyses.
audioPurpose: Provide benchmark model of an executive analytical causal briefing.
successCriteria: Delivers a coherent 2-minute oral presentation using at least 3 distinct causal connectors
Structures argument logically from underlying condition to direct trigger to final outcome
masteryEvidence: Speaks for 2 minutes stating 'Ханшийн өсөлтөөс шалтгаалан импортын түүхий эдийн үнэ нэмэгдсэн тул төслийн төсөв 15 хувиар хэтэрсэн юм' fluently.

title: Immediate Succession in Discourse: The Contemporaneous Converb -магц/-мэгц
primaryPurpose: Introduce the contemporaneous converb suffix -магц⁴ denoting immediate temporal succession ('as soon as', 'no sooner than') linking two consecutive events in narrative time.
communicativeOutcome: Formulate narrative clauses expressing rapid reaction and chronological immediacy (ирэнгүүт/ирмэгц, хармагц, сонсмогц).
writingObjective: Transform 8 base verbs into contemporaneous converbs and embed them into chronological narrative sentences.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe 3 spontaneous reactions you had immediately upon hearing surprising news.
registerTarget: Standard narrative and literary spoken/written register
pragmaticTarget: Using -магц to convey high narrative velocity and immediate cause-and-effect sequencing.
reviewReason: Bridges causal conjunctions into chronological sequence converbs.
audioPurpose: Model proper articulation of the consonant cluster -гц without epenthetic vowel insertion.
successCriteria: Applies -магц/-мэгц/-могц/-мөгц adhering strictly to 4-fold vowel harmony
Constructs complex sentences indicating that event B occurred immediately upon event A
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Гэртээ харьмагц утсаа цэнэглэв' and 'Мэдээг сонсмогц ажилдаа яарав' flawlessly.

title: Temporal Velocity Lexicon: Suddenness, Immediacy & Trigger Events
primaryPurpose: Acquire vivid adverbs of suddenness, perceptual verbs, and trigger expressions (тэр даруй, хоромхон зуур, агшин зуур, гэнэт) that pair with -магц in narrative storytelling.
communicativeOutcome: Narrate dynamic emergency reactions and dramatic real-life incidents with rich temporal coloring.
writingObjective: Draft a 4-sentence dramatic vignette describing an emergency evacuation using temporal velocity adverbs and -магц.
spokenProductionObjective: Narrate an unexpected encounter with an old acquaintance on the street.
registerTarget: Expressive oral narrative and literary prose register
pragmaticTarget: Heightening suspense through precise combinations of converbs and immediacy adverbs.
reviewReason: Integrates sudden incident vocabulary with contemporaneous converbial syntax.
audioPurpose: Provide audio pronunciation of dynamic adverbial collocations.
successCriteria: Pairs temporal velocity adverbs accurately with contemporaneous converb clauses
Maintains chronological momentum across multi-clause narrative sequences
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Галын дохио дуугармагц бүх ажилчид тэр даруй гадаа гарсан' with natural pacing.

title: Reading Analysis: Eyewitness Chronicles & Investigative Memoirs
primaryPurpose: Analyze excerpts from contemporary Mongolian memoirs, travelogues, and investigative journalistic dispatches recounting fast-moving historical and natural events.
communicativeOutcome: Trace complex chronological timelines, instantaneous reactions, and consequence chains in published non-fiction.
readingObjective: Read a 250-word eyewitness account of a sudden mountain blizzard and sequence 5 rapid events in chronological order.
registerTarget: Literary non-fiction and investigative narrative register
pragmaticTarget: Tracking narrative flashbacks vs forward temporal leaps in authored chronicles.
reviewReason: Deepens reading comprehension from analytical whitepapers to vivid literary memoirs.
audioPurpose: Narration of memoir excerpt with atmospheric expressive cadence.
successCriteria: Correctly maps 5 sequenced narrative events from the text onto a chronological timeline
Identifies -магц converbs serving as temporal hinge points in the chronicle
masteryEvidence: Identifies that the mountaineers erected the tent immediately upon noticing the sudden wind change.

title: Spoken Production: Delivering an Eyewitness Account of a Critical Incident
primaryPurpose: Deliver a 2-minute structured oral monologue giving a detailed eyewitness account of a dramatic real-world event (traffic accident, storm arrival, sudden market surge).
communicativeOutcome: Narrate an eventful sequence of occurrences with vivid temporal precision, emotional engagement, and syntactic cohesion.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver a 2-minute oral monologue recounting a fast-unfolding crisis using -магц at least 3 times.
registerTarget: Engaging spoken narrative testimonial register
pragmaticTarget: Balancing personal affective reaction with precise chronological factual accuracy.
reviewReason: Synthesizes analytical cause-and-effect with temporal narrative dynamism in spoken monologue.

successCriteria: Speaks for 90-120 seconds sustaining uninterrupted chronological flow
Integrates at least 3 contemporaneous converbs correctly without consonant cluster degradation
masteryEvidence: Delivers 'Би галт тэргийг зогсмогц бууж, тусламж дуудсан бөгөөд эмч нар ирмэгц шархагсдад туслав' fluently.

title: Continuous Persistence: The Durative Converb -саар/-сээр (Process & Progression)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the durative converb suffix -саар⁴ indicating: 1) continuous, uninterrupted persistence of an action over extended time, and 2) persisting state leading up to an outcome (-саар ... боллоо / байсаар ирэв).
communicativeOutcome: Formulate clauses expressing unbroken duration, sustained ongoing habits, and long-term evolutionary trends.
writingObjective: Transform 8 base verbs into durative converbs and construct sentences expressing continuous perseverance.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain an educational or artistic discipline you have practiced persistently over many years.
registerTarget: Formal spoken and written narrative register
pragmaticTarget: Emphasizing patient determination and endurance through aspectual duration.
reviewReason: Contrasts instantaneous temporal succession (-магц) with protracted persistence (-саар).
audioPurpose: Model proper long vowel duration in -саар/-сээр/-соор/-сөөр.
successCriteria: Attaches -саар⁴ to consonant and vowel stems with proper phonological elision
Pairs durative converb accurately with auxiliary verbs (байна, байв, ирэв)
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Бид хичээсээр байгаад эцэст нь зорилгодоо хүрсэн' with perfect inflection.

title: Perseverance & Evolution Lexicon: Endurance, Historical Change & Gradual Shifts
primaryPurpose: Acquire vocabulary denoting gradual development, perseverance through adversity, incremental transformation, and historic shifts (аажмаар, тасралтгүй, тууштай, үе дамжин).
communicativeOutcome: Describe long-term personal, societal, and technological transformations in rich Mongolian prose.
writingObjective: Draft 4 sentences illustrating the gradual evolution of nomadic life into modern urbanization using targeted lexicon.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain how modern smartphone technology has gradually changed everyday lifestyle habits.
registerTarget: Reflective narrative and analytical social register
pragmaticTarget: Conveying respect for long-term dedication and inter-generational continuity.
reviewReason: Enriches the grammatical durative morpheme with dedicated perseverance vocabulary.
audioPurpose: Pronunciation of formal compound adverbs and socio-historical terminology.
successCriteria: Correctly pairs adverbs of gradualness with durative verbs (аажмаар өөрчлөгдсөөр, тасралтгүй хөгжсөөр)
Forms cohesive multi-clause sentences depicting long historical arcs
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Монгол ахуй соёл үе дамжин өвлөгдсөөр өнөөгийн түвшинд хүрч иржээ' accurately.

title: Reading Analysis: Life Stories of Renowned Mongolian Artisans & Scientists
primaryPurpose: Read and deconstruct published biographies of celebrated Mongolian figures (morin khuur masters, geologists, Olympic athletes) detailing decades of sustained mastery.
communicativeOutcome: Comprehend complex biographical narratives, identifying turning points, years of perseverance, and culminating life achievements.
readingObjective: Read a 300-word biography of a traditional woodcarver and trace his 40-year career progression through durative converbial markers.
registerTarget: High literary biography and cultural journalism register
pragmaticTarget: Recognizing traditional cultural honorifics and tributes to lifelong apprenticeship.
reviewReason: Expands non-fiction reading from fast-paced crisis journalism to long-arc biographical prose.
audioPurpose: Narration of biographical passage with dignified, reflective intonation.
successCriteria: Identifies key milestones along a 40-year career narrative
Extracts durative converbial structures and temporal duration markers
masteryEvidence: Extracts that the artisan honed his carving technique for 15 years before crafting his first state ceremonial bow.

title: Spoken Production: Narrating a Personal Journey of Sustained Endeavor
primaryPurpose: Deliver an extended 2.5-minute oral narrative chronicling a personal pursuit, language journey, or athletic challenge undertaken over months or years.
communicativeOutcome: Share an inspirational personal anecdote demonstrating sustained endeavor, obstacles overcome, and enduring habits formed.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver a 2.5-minute autobiographical narrative on learning Mongolian using durative converbs to denote ongoing effort.
registerTarget: Warm, engaging autobiographical storytelling register
pragmaticTarget: Connecting personal growth to universal themes of persistence and resilience.
reviewReason: Pairs sudden dramatic narrative capability (-магц) with long-duration personal storytelling (-саар).

successCriteria: Narrates smoothly for 120-150 seconds with minimal pause breaks
Integrates durative converbs (-саар) to describe ongoing habits and gradual breakthroughs
masteryEvidence: Delivers 'Би өдөр бүр үг цээжилсээр, радио сонссоор байгаад монголоор чөлөөтэй ярьдаг боллоо' with expressive confidence.

title: Manner & Concomitance: The Modal Converb Suffix -н (Action Interconnection)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the modal converb of manner suffix -н attached directly to verbal stems (with connective vowel after consonants) indicating how or in what manner the principal action is executed (инээмсэглэн хэлэх, гүйн очих, даван туулах).
communicativeOutcome: Formulate sophisticated verbal chains expressing simultaneous manner and compound action in narrative prose.
writingObjective: Transform 8 base verbs into modal converbs of manner and combine them with main action predicates.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe how someone entered a room and greeted the audience using -н manner converbs.
registerTarget: Refined literary and formal descriptive register
pragmaticTarget: Using -н to fuse manner seamlessly with main verbs rather than using clumsy adjectival phrases.
reviewReason: Expands converb inventory from temporal sequence (-магц) and duration (-саар) to manner of action (-н).
audioPurpose: Demonstrate the short connective vowel before -н (уншин, яван, харсаар vs харан).
successCriteria: Selects correct connective vowel (ы/и/у/ү) before -н based on stem phonology
Forms tight verbal collocations denoting manner of execution
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Тэрээр гар даллан биднийг угтав' and 'Гүйцэтгэлийг нарийвчлан шалгав' accurately.

title: Manner, Posture & Behavioral Lexicon: Expressive Physical & Psychological Verbs
primaryPurpose: Acquire expressive descriptive verbs denoting physical postures, facial expressions, psychological attitudes, and movement modalities (тээнэгэлзэх, бэлэгшээх, сөгдөх, тонгойх, алхах).

writingObjective: Formulate 4 sentences depicting interpersonal greetings and ceremonial conduct using posture verbs in -н.
spokenProductionObjective: Describe a traditional Mongolian greeting ritual highlighting respectful posture and mannerisms.
registerTarget: Culturally grounded narrative and ceremonial register
pragmaticTarget: Reflecting Mongolian cultural decorum (ёс жаяг) through respectful posture descriptors.
reviewReason: Pairs the grammatical manner converb with specialized descriptive vocabulary.
audioPurpose: Provide audio pronunciation of evocative manner verbs.
successCriteria: Pairs posture verbs correctly with -н (бөхийн мэндлэх, гар барин золгох)
Uses behavioral descriptors appropriately within cultural narrative contexts
masteryEvidence: Produces 'Ахмад настантай хоёр гараа сунган мэндлэв' with cultural accuracy.

title: Reading Analysis: Contemporary Mongolian Short Stories & Novellas
primaryPurpose: Deconstruct excerpts from prominent modern Mongolian literary fiction (e.g. stories by D. Batbayar, S. Erdene, or B. Dogmid) rich in converbial chaining with -н.
communicativeOutcome: Appreciate literary aesthetic nuance, decipher descriptive atmosphere, and interpret character motivations.

pragmaticTarget: Appreciating poetic subtext and unspoken emotion in contemporary Mongolian literature.
reviewReason: Advances reading from non-fiction biographical accounts to imaginative literary prose.

successCriteria: Identifies manner converbs and explains their contribution to character depiction
Interprets underlying emotional atmosphere established by literary verbal chaining

communicativeOutcome: Bring a character to life through spoken storytelling, integrating manner, posture, and speech patterns.
spokenProductionObjective: Deliver a 2-minute oral character sketch using -н converbs to depict posture and attitude vividly.

successCriteria: Delivers a 2-minute spoken character sketch integrating at least 3 modal converbs of manner
Varies pacing and intonation to match character gestures and humorous traits
masteryEvidence: Delivers 'Өвгөн малгайгаа аван, инээмсэглэн толгой дохиод бидэнд замаа зааж өгсөн юм' with evocative warmth.

title: Incidental Simultaneity: The Limiting Converb -нгаа/-нгээ (Multitasking & Secondary Actions)
primaryPurpose: Introduce the limiting/incidental converb suffix -нгаа⁴ expressing: 1) doing a secondary action concurrently while primarily engaged in another ('while doing X, on the way, simultaneously'), and 2) taking advantage of an opportunity to perform an incidental task (далимдуулан).
communicativeOutcome: Formulate compound sentences describing multitasking, concurrent activities, and opportunistic secondary tasks in daily life and work.
writingObjective: Transform 8 verb stems into limiting converbs and construct sentences describing concurrent work and study habits.
spokenProductionObjective: Explain two activities you regularly conduct simultaneously during your morning commute or lunch hour.
registerTarget: Conversational and professional everyday workflow register
pragmaticTarget: Highlighting time efficiency and multitasking capability in daily routines.
